title: Dynamics of hyperpolarized nuclear spins at Zeeman-insensitive points
summary: Avoided crossing (LAC) transitions are central to spin-based precision measurements since they provide strong observability and field-perturbation insensitivity, but while observed commonly in isolated-atom or engineered solid-state platforms, such transitions are unexploited in molecules in liquids. Here we report a solution-state, nuclear-spin LAC transition in hyperpolarized [1-$^{13}$C]-fumarate.
